summary: Iteration 2 testing complete for Sentinel AI. All 4 new features (Mongo-persisted channels+rules, real notification delivery with MOCKED fallback, ⌘K command palette, WebSocket live overview) work end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 new tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2_features.py + 28/28 regression tests in /app/backend/tests/test_sentinel_backend.py (total 38/38, 100%). Frontend Playwright verified: quick-login all roles, live-indicator turns green with 'LIVE · WS' immediately after WS opens, ⌘K opens command-palette, typing 'kafka' filters + Enter navigates to /kafka, header-search opens palette, typing free-form + clicking 'Ask AI Copilot' navigates to /copilot?q=... and Copilot auto-sends, notifications page shows configured (green check) vs mocked (amber triangle), config-slack opens config-form-slack, save-config-slack persists, test-slack toast shows 'HTTP 404: no_team' (real Slack send attempted with fake webhook), fire-{ruleId} shows 'fired N channel(s) · X delivered · Y mocked' toast, history table has DELIVERED/MOCKED/FAILED badges, VIEWER RBAC returns 403 with 'Insufficient permissions' toast, no nav-admin for VIEWER.

ui_bugs.issue: When arriving via /copilot?q=<text>, the query is auto-sent TWICE (visible as two identical user bubbles). Root cause: React 18 StrictMode intentionally invokes effects twice in dev, and the `messages.length === 0` guard doesn't help because state updates are async. This is visible in the UI screenshot and causes 2x LLM tokens billed per invocation. Fix: use a ref (e.g., `const firedRef = useRef(false)`) inside the auto-send effect to guarantee single execution.

issues: Console warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' from Recharts ResponsiveContainer. Cosmetic (charts still render correctly once layout settles) but noisy in console. Add minWidth/minHeight to container or use aspect ratio.

action_items: MEDIUM: Guard CopilotPage auto-send effect with a useRef flag so /copilot?q=... doesn't fire twice under React.StrictMode (see frontend_issues.ui_bugs).
OPTIONAL: silence Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on OverviewPage by giving ResponsiveContainer minHeight or explicit height on its parent.
OPTIONAL (already noted in iter1): server.py is now 1036 lines. Consider splitting into routers/notifications.py, routers/copilot.py, routers/admin.py — /app/backend/routers/ already exists.
critical_code_review_comments: notifications.py delivery() gracefully falls back to MOCKED when webhook/api_key missing — good. Consider adding a per-provider retry (single retry on 5xx) since Slack/Teams occasionally 502.

server.py _sanitize_channel masks 'api_key' and 'webhook_url' but not future secret keys (e.g., 'bearer_token', 'signing_secret'). Consider a SECRET_KEYS set + centralised helper so new provider configs don't accidentally leak.
server.py trigger_alert_rule iterates channels sequentially; each httpx.post is 10s timeout — with 5 real channels that is 50s worst-case. Consider asyncio.gather for parallel dispatch.

WebSocket /api/ws/live has no ping/heartbeat — if a proxy idles the connection, client will silently miss ticks. Recommend setting websockets ping_interval or send periodic {kind:'ping'} beyond ticks.
useLiveOverview.js retries on close but does not reconnect on token expiry (401 close). If JWT rolls, WS reconnect loop will hammer server. Consider detecting close code 1008 → force user to re-auth.
